integrity: The proof derives the two defining conditions directly from complete-multipartite neighborhoods, then counts all support-valid labelings and subtracts exactly the zero-containing parts with outside weight one, including their sole pairwise-overlap case. A separate exhaustive checker tests all ternary assignments and every coefficient through order nine.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to connected complete multipartite graphs and the standard total Roman {2}-domination definition.
The complete-multipartite minimum total Roman {2}-domination number is prior-published and is not the originality basis.
Finite exhaustive verification through order nine is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude differently phrased or non-indexed all-function enumerations.
title: Weight enumerator of total Roman \{2\}-domination on complete multipartite graphs
